problem: Priya and her cousin Tomo spent Sunday at the farm picking strawberries together. They filled 50 baskets, and 28 of those were Priya's. How many baskets did Tomo fill?
follow_up_questions: In the evening Tomo filled 13 more baskets. How many baskets did Tomo fill in total that day?

problem: How many jars did Kofi label, if he and Mira labelled 50 jars of honey together and Mira did 28 of them?
follow_up_questions: Later Kofi labelled another 13 jars. What is the number of jars Kofi labelled altogether?

problem: At the end of the month the swimming pool's lost-property box held 31 towels. The plain ones were mixed in with 12 striped ones. The pool smelled strongly of chlorine. How many plain towels were there?
Find how many mugs have no pattern. A café shelf holds 31 mugs, and twelve of them have spots while the rest have no pattern at all. The café has big windows facing the sea.
On a snowy Sunday, Mateus built two model kits at the kitchen table. The castle kit had 48 parts and the ship kit had 35 parts. How many parts did he put together in all?
follow_up_questions: Then his cat knocked 6 parts off the ship model. How many parts were still on the ship?

problem: What is the total number of beads Aiko threaded? She made a bracelet with 35 beads after finishing a necklace with 48 beads.
follow_up_questions: Afterwards 6 beads slipped off the bracelet. How many beads were left on the bracelet?

problem: At the holiday club, 28 children chose an afternoon activity: 13 went swimming and the rest went to the art room. How many children went to the art room?
follow_up_questions: The next afternoon, 4 more children chose the art room than on this afternoon. How many chose art the next afternoon?
On that next afternoon, how many children went swimming?

problem: How many campers went fishing, if 13 of the 28 campers at the lake went canoeing and every other camper fished?
follow_up_questions: The following day, the number who fished was 4 bigger. How many fished that day?
How many campers canoed on the following day?

problem: In the bakery window there are two trays of rolls: 26 on the lower tray and 30 on the upper tray. How many rolls are on the trays in total?
Find the total number of books on Grandma Rosa's two shelves. The top shelf holds 30 books, while the bottom shelf has 26.
The 27 members of the choir practised two songs on Saturday. They rehearsed the first song for 45 minutes and the second for 38 minutes. How long did they practise in total?
follow_up_questions: Afterwards they took a 10-minute rest. How many minutes had gone by since practice began?
The bus collected them 7 minutes after the rest finished. How many minutes passed from the start of practice until the bus came?

problem: How many minutes did Lena spend in the garden? With her 6 chickens pecking nearby, she weeded for 45 minutes and then watered for 38 minutes.
follow_up_questions: She then sat on the bench for 10 minutes. How many minutes had passed since she started weeding?
Dinner was ready 7 minutes after she left the bench. How many minutes passed from the start of weeding to dinner?

problem: Lena's bakery sold 79 cinnamon buns on Monday. Friday was quieter, with fewer customers, and only 68 buns were sold. How many buns did the bakery sell on those two days?
follow_up_questions: The following week it sold 54 buns. How many buns were sold in the two weeks together?

problem: Work out how many tickets the museum sold over the weekend: 68 on Sunday, though fewer visitors came, and 79 on Saturday.
follow_up_questions: The next weekend 54 tickets were sold. What is the total for the two weekends?

problem: Kofi and Hannah share the diving board with their coach for a 60-minute session. Kofi dives for 25 minutes and Hannah for 20 minutes. If the coach has the rest of the session, how many minutes does she get?
How much time is left for Grandpa on the piano? The family shares the piano for 60 minutes each evening; Lucia plays for 20 minutes and Dev for 25 minutes before him.
Children threw 30 paper planes in all from the top of the hill. 17 of them glided past the hedge. How many came down in the meadow?
follow_up_questions: Of the planes in the meadow, 4 had crumpled wings. How many good planes were in the meadow?
The children fixed 2 of the crumpled ones. How many good planes are in the meadow now?

problem: How many beanbags landed in the yard, if 17 of the 30 beanbags thrown in all at the school fete flew over the wall?
follow_up_questions: Of the beanbags in the yard, 4 had split open. How many whole beanbags were in the yard?
A helper sewed up 2 of the split ones. How many whole beanbags are in the yard now?

problem: Ms. Tanaka is packing the class picnic: 24 pears, 48 cheese slices and 36 bread rolls go into the cool box. How many food items is that?
follow_up_questions: When the picnic ended, 18 items were left over. How many were eaten?
Her 2 helpers shared the leftover items equally. How many did each helper take home?

problem: How many things did the camp kitchen order? It got 24 bananas, 36 yogurts and 48 muffins for the Saturday hike.
follow_up_questions: After the hike, 18 of the things had not been eaten. Find how many were eaten.
The two cooks split the uneaten things equally. How many did each cook get?

problem: The 25 pupils in the art class each painted one animal for a mural that has 6 panels. 14 painted a tiger and the rest painted a lion. How many painted a lion?
follow_up_questions: Later, 3 of the lion painters switched to tigers. How many tiger paintings were there then?

problem: How many campers chose the canoe? At the lake, 14 of the 25 campers chose the raft and the rest chose the canoe, and the camp has 9 cabins.
follow_up_questions: On the second day, 3 canoe campers moved over to the raft. How many campers were on the raft then?

problem: With 34 children and 6 helpers on board, the bus to the aquarium pulled away at 8 o'clock. How many people were riding the bus?
follow_up_questions: At the aquarium, 25 people from a seniors' club joined them for the dolphin show. How many people watched the show?
Before the shark talk, 19 of them went to the café. How many stayed for the talk?

problem: How many people boarded the ferry? There were 34 choir singers and 6 teachers, and the ferry sailed at 10 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: On the island, 25 local singers joined them for the concert. How many people sang in the concert?
After the concert, 19 of them went to the beach. How many did not go to the beach?

problem: Kemal has filled 18 pages of his new sticker album since his birthday. The album has 30 pages in all. How many pages are still blank?
follow_up_questions: In June he fills 5 more pages. How many blank pages are left?
His uncle gives him a second album with 20 pages. How many blank pages does he have now?
Over the summer he uses 9 pages for football stickers. How many blank pages remain?

problem: A photo album holds 30 pages. Find the number of empty pages if Nadia has already filled 18 with holiday pictures.
follow_up_questions: She fills 5 more pages after a trip to the zoo. How many empty pages does it have now?
Her mum buys her a refill pack of 20 pages. What is the number of empty pages now?
Birthday photos take up 9 of those pages. How many empty pages are left?

problem: Greta is building a birdhouse with her grandpa. The plan lists 16 short nails for the walls and 12 long nails for the roof. What is the total number of nails she needs?
follow_up_questions: She already has 9 nails in her tin. How many more nails does she need?
Her grandpa hands her 10 of them. How many nails does Greta still need to find?

problem: How many beads does the necklace pattern need? It calls for 12 large beads and 16 small beads.
follow_up_questions: Sami has 9 beads already. How many more does he need?
A friend gives him 10. What number of beads is he still missing?

problem: At the market, Rosa's basket is full of plums and apricots, 64 fruits in total. She counts 37 plums. Work out how many apricots are in the basket.
There are 64 marbles in Tunde's jar, and every one is either blue or green. Find how many green ones there are when 37 are blue.
Of the 21 children in the drama group, 13 want to act on stage. The others will work as stagehands. The group rehearses in Hall 5. How many stagehands are there?
follow_up_questions: Next month, 4 actors will move to the stagehand team. How many stagehands will there be then?

problem: How many children joined the singing team? At the 3 o'clock club, 21 children split between singing and dancing, and 13 picked dancing.
follow_up_questions: Next term, 4 dancers plan to switch to singing. How many singers will there be then?

problem: A snail sets off across a 50-centimetre garden path. After crawling 32 centimetres it rests under a leaf. The rain has just stopped. What distance is left for the snail to crawl?
follow_up_questions: The next day it tries a path that is 15 centimetres longer. From the same resting point, how far would it have to crawl?

problem: How many metres are left for the swimmer? Ana has to swim 50 metres, but she rests after 32 metres. The water is warm today.
follow_up_questions: In the next lesson the race is made 15 metres longer. How many metres would she have left from her resting point?

problem: Mr. Haddad's class is gluing lolly sticks into a model bridge. They glued 27 sticks in the first lesson and 36 in the second. The glue made their fingers sticky. How many sticks are in the bridge?
follow_up_questions: In the third lesson they pulled off 8 sticks that were crooked. How many sticks were still on the bridge?
In the fourth lesson they glued on 14 new sticks. How many sticks are in the bridge now?
The finished bridge needs 80 sticks. How many more sticks must they add?

problem: How many tiles did the mosaic have after two days? Bea set 36 tiles on Saturday and 27 on Friday. Her apron was covered in grout.
follow_up_questions: Then she removed 8 tiles that were cracked. How many tiles were left in the mosaic?
She added 14 fresh tiles. How many tiles are in the mosaic now?
The whole design has 80 tiles. How many tiles are still to be set?

problem: Jonas picked 87 apples in the orchard this week, and Mariko picked 76. They are saving them for the harvest fair, which is 3 weeks away. What is the total number of apples they picked?
follow_up_questions: Jonas found that 18 of his apples were bruised. How many good apples did Jonas have?
Counting Jonas's good apples and all of Mariko's apples, what is the total?

problem: What is the total number of laps swum by two swimmers in a pool with 8 lanes? Ellie swam 87 laps this month and Ruth swam 76.
follow_up_questions: Ellie's coach did not count 18 of her laps. How many of Ellie's laps counted?
Adding Ellie's counted laps to all of Ruth's laps, how many laps is that?

problem: Grown-ups get blue tickets and children get yellow ones at the library's puppet show. The librarian printed 85 yellow tickets and 96 blue tickets. How many tickets did she print?
follow_up_questions: On the day, 23 tickets were never used. How many tickets were used?

problem: Exactly how many programmes did the theatre print, if it made 85 for the matinee and 96 for the evening show?
follow_up_questions: By the end of the night 23 programmes were left over. How many were handed out?

problem: In the art room there is a tub with 75 crayons altogether. Amir sorts out 26 yellow ones and 19 purple ones; every other crayon is orange. How many orange crayons are there?
follow_up_questions: On Monday the class used up 12 orange crayons. How many orange crayons are left?
On Tuesday a parent sent in 25 orange crayons. How many orange crayons are there now?
How many crayons of all colours are in the tub now?

problem: How many marbles in Ravi's bag are green? Altogether the bag holds 75 marbles; 19 are clear, 26 are striped and the rest are green.
follow_up_questions: He loses 12 green marbles in a game. How many green marbles are left?
His cousin gives him 25 green marbles. How many green ones does he have now?
Counting every kind, how many marbles are in the bag now?

problem: A jar of 32 marbles tipped over on Leah's desk, and 25 marbles stayed on the desk. Her dog barked at the noise. How many marbles rolled onto the floor?
follow_up_questions: She picked up 4 of them before dinner. How many were still on the floor?
How many marbles were on the desk now?

problem: How many crayons fell on the floor when the 32-crayon box slipped from Omar's hands? He found 25 crayons still on his table. The box had a picture of a tiger on it.
follow_up_questions: Omar picked 4 of them up before the bell. How many crayons were still on the floor?
How many crayons were back on his table then?

problem: 26 of the 44 swimmers in the swimming club are still learners; the others swim in the fast group. Training starts at 5 o'clock on Mondays. How many swimmers are in the fast group?
follow_up_questions: By summer, 7 learners had moved up to the fast group. How many swimmers were in the fast group then?
How many learners were left?

problem: Work out how many of the 44 dancers at the ballet school are not beginners. 26 of them are beginners, and the school has 3 studios.
follow_up_questions: By winter, 7 beginners had become senior dancers. How many dancers were not beginners then?
How many beginners remained?

problem: The pottery class needed three loads in the kiln to fire its 96 bowls. The first load held 47 bowls and the second 28. How many bowls went into the third load?
How many pancakes were flipped in the evening? The camp cooks made 96 pancakes over the whole day: 28 at lunch, 47 at breakfast and the rest in the evening.
The hockey team's spring season had 67 home games and 58 away games. What was the total number of games?
What is the total number of postcards in Ilse's collection if 67 came from her aunt and 58 came from her travels?
The drama group wants new costumes. It held a bake sale that made 54 dollars and a sponsored walk, and together they raised 90 dollars. How much money did the walk raise?
follow_up_questions: In April they raised another 48 dollars. How much money do they have now?
One costume costs 46 dollars. How many costumes can the group buy with all the money?

problem: How much money did the garden club make from its plant sale? The club collected 90 dollars in all, and 54 dollars of it came from a raffle; the rest came from the plant sale.
follow_up_questions: Then a neighbour gave 48 dollars. How much money does the club have now?
A new wheelbarrow costs 46 dollars. How many wheelbarrows can the club buy with all of that money?

problem: Tomasz is learning to juggle. In the first week of the summer he managed 39 catches, and in the second week he managed 64. Find his total number of catches.
Find how many laps Zuri ran around the track: 64 laps during May and 39 during April.
Ahmed won 12 of the tennis matches he played against Lily this summer. They played 20 matches altogether and none was a tie. How many matches did Lily win?
How many races did Pip win? Pip and Juno ran 20 races altogether last summer, with no ties, and Juno won 12.

Volunteers are painting the 64 boards of the new playground fence bright blue. On Saturday 27 boards got a coat, and on Sunday 19 more. A robin watched them from a tree. How many boards have no paint yet?
follow_up_questions: On Monday half of the unpainted boards were painted. How many boards was that?
How many boards still need paint after Monday?
On Tuesday a team painted those last boards and then repainted 6 boards that had been scratched. How many boards did Tuesday's team paint?

problem: How many floor tiles in the hallway still need scrubbing? There are 64 tiles; the cleaners scrubbed 19 in the morning and 27 at lunchtime. The hallway smells of soap.
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon they scrubbed half of the tiles still waiting. How many tiles was that?
How many tiles were still waiting after the afternoon?
In the evening one cleaner finished those tiles and then went over 6 tiles with muddy footprints again. How many tiles did that cleaner scrub in the evening?

problem: The farm children went egg hunting three times on Sunday and found 85 eggs in all. The morning hunt found 38 and the noon hunt found 29. How many did the evening hunt find?
follow_up_questions: That night the farmer sold 40 of the eggs. How many eggs were not sold?
On Monday morning the family cooked 17 more for breakfast. How many eggs were left after breakfast?

problem: How many shells were gathered at sunset, if the children picked up 85 shells over the day at the beach, 29 of them after lunch and 38 before lunch?
follow_up_questions: Back at the cottage, they glued 40 shells onto a box. How many shells were not glued?
The next morning they gave 17 more to their cousins. How many shells were left?

problem: The twins' lemonade stand did less business than usual because of the cold. Still, they poured 76 cups on Saturday and 58 on Sunday. What is their total for the weekend?
What is the number of newspapers Abdul delivered over two days? He delivered 58 on Tuesday, which felt less tiring than Monday, when he delivered 76.
Thirty runners lined up for the school fun run, but only 18 had remembered a water bottle. The others had left theirs at home. A flag flapped above the finish line. How many runners had no bottle?
follow_up_questions: The teacher handed out 8 spare bottles. How many runners were still without one?
At the break, every runner who had a bottle filled it 2 times. How many fills was that?
The big cooler held enough water for 9 more fills. Counting those, how many fills could the runners make?

problem: How many cyclists had no helmet light? Thirty cyclists met at the park gate for a night ride, and eighteen had a helmet light. The moon was full and bright.
follow_up_questions: The ride leader had 8 spare lights. How many cyclists were still without a light?
Every cyclist with a light changed its batteries 2 times during the season. How many battery changes was that?
The leader also kept enough batteries for 9 more changes. Counting those, how many battery changes could the group make?

problem: Mrs. Ito sold 45 candles at the craft fair, which opens at 9 o'clock. Scented candles made up 27 of her sales. How many of the candles she sold had no scent?
How many medals were for swimming? At the 3-day sports camp, the coaches gave out 45 medals: 27 for running and the rest for swimming.
The crew of the sailing boat carried 79 bottles of juice on board, then 64 bottles of water. How many bottles did they load for the trip?
follow_up_questions: During the trip they drank 98 bottles. How many bottles came back to the harbour?
Back on shore they shared those bottles equally among 5 sailors. How many bottles did each sailor get?
One sailor gave 6 of his bottles to the harbour master. How many did that sailor keep?

problem: How many jars of jam did Grandma Elif make this summer, if she made 79 jars of plum jam and 64 jars of cherry jam?
follow_up_questions: Her family ate 98 jars over the winter. How many jars were still in the cellar?
She shared the jars in the cellar equally among her 5 grandchildren. How many jars did each grandchild get?
One grandchild gave 6 jars to a teacher. How many jars did that grandchild keep?

problem: Amina's family is cycling a 47-kilometre trail over three days. They rode 18 kilometres on the first day and 15 on the second. What distance is left for the last day?
follow_up_questions: On the last day they ride half of that distance before lunch. How many kilometres do they ride before lunch?
Next year the trail will be 9 kilometres longer. How long will it be?

problem: How far does the canoe club paddle on the last day? Its river trip is 47 kilometres long; on day one they paddle 15 kilometres and on day two 18 kilometres.
follow_up_questions: On the last day they cover half of that distance before stopping for a picnic. How far do they paddle before the picnic?
Next summer the trip will be 9 kilometres longer. What will its length be?

problem: Cupcakes flew off the table at Friday's bake sale: 22 sold in the morning and 17 more in the afternoon. How many cupcakes were sold in all?
follow_up_questions: On Saturday they sold 14 cupcakes. How many did they sell over the two days?

problem: How many dogs did Yara walk on Saturday? She walked 17 dogs after lunch and 22 dogs before lunch.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday she walked 14 dogs. What is the total for the weekend?

problem: Nadia counted the 60 books in the class library box on Friday. 34 were storybooks and the rest were comics. The box gets tidied at 3 o'clock each week. How many comics were in the box?
follow_up_questions: The next week the box held 12 more comics than this week. How many comics did it hold then?

problem: How many pears were in the fruit bowl? The bowl, filled at 7 o'clock every morning, held 60 pieces of fruit on Monday: 34 apples and the rest pears.
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday the bowl held 12 more pears than on Monday. How many pears was that?

problem: At the swimming gala, the Sharks have 25 swimmers. Together with the Dolphins there are 48 swimmers. How many Dolphins are there?
follow_up_questions: On Friday every swimmer in the smaller team brought 2 towels. How many towels did that team bring?

problem: How many singers are in the second choir, if the two choirs at the spring concert have 48 singers in total and the first choir has 25?
follow_up_questions: Each singer in the smaller choir holds 2 song sheets. How many song sheets does that choir need?

problem: Mina packed 14 glass bottles of juice into the beach bag, along with 9 towels. How many things did she pack?
follow_up_questions: On the way, 3 of the bottles cracked. How many bottles reached the beach safely?

problem: How many things did Mr. Lund carry to the church sale? He brought 14 china plates and 9 cookbooks.
follow_up_questions: He dropped 3 of the plates on the steps and they broke. How many plates arrived safely?

problem: The school's reading challenge ran for a month. Younger pupils finished 69 books and older pupils finished 87. What is the number of books the school read?
follow_up_questions: A local shop gave 2 cents for every book read. How many cents did the school get?
The school spent 95 cents of it on bookmarks. How many cents were left?

problem: How many cans did the town collect in the can drive? The east side brought in 69 cans and the west side brought in 87.
follow_up_questions: The scrap dealer paid 2 cents for each can. How many cents did the town earn?
The town spent 95 cents on a thank-you card. How many cents remained?

problem: There were 40 toys on the playroom floor. Kenzo dropped 23 of them into the toy chest and lined up the rest on the shelf. His little sister was asleep upstairs. How many toys ended up on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: Then he found 5 more toys for the shelf behind the sofa. How many toys went onto the shelf in all?

problem: How many letters went into the Paris pile? Grace sorted 40 letters at the office, putting 23 in the London pile and the rest in the Paris pile. Her coffee had gone cold.
follow_up_questions: Later she found 5 more Paris letters in her bag. How many letters ended up in the Paris pile?

problem: By noon on Tuesday, Fiona had dropped off 46 of the 70 parcels in her van. How many parcels does she still have to deliver?
How many seats still need wiping? The cinema has 70 seats, and Hugo has wiped 46 of them since the film ended.

The class nature table needed pine cones, so Hiro and Esme went to the woods. Hiro brought back 29, and the two of them brought 55 in total. A squirrel watched them the whole time. How many cones did Esme bring?
follow_up_questions: They used 40 cones in a big display on Monday. How many cones did they still have?
On Tuesday Esme brought in 10 more cones. How many cones were waiting to be used?

problem: How many shells did Leon gather, if he and Maya gathered 55 shells together for a sandcastle and Maya found 29? The beach was very windy.
follow_up_questions: They pressed 40 shells into the castle walls. How many shells were not used?
Then Leon found 10 more shells. How many shells were waiting to go on the castle?

problem: New books keep arriving at the school library. There were 73 in the first delivery and 58 in the second. How many books came in the two deliveries?
follow_up_questions: Volunteers put 96 of the books on the shelves. How many books were not shelved?
Then 27 more books arrived. How many unshelved books are there now?
If 2 books go into each display basket, how many baskets can they fill with the unshelved books?

problem: Find the number of sacks of potatoes the farm shop got this week: 58 on Thursday and 73 on Wednesday.
follow_up_questions: The shop sold 96 of the sacks. How many sacks were not sold?
On Friday 27 more sacks were delivered. How many unsold sacks does the shop have now?
If the shop stacks 2 sacks on each pallet, how many pallets does it need for the unsold sacks?

problem: Thirty-nine of the bags in the pet shop's store room hold cat food; the rest hold dog food. Altogether there are 64 bags. How many bags of dog food are there?
follow_up_questions: On Saturday, 11 bags of dog food were sold. How many dog food bags remain?

problem: How many tins of red paint does the hardware store have, if its 64 tins of red and white paint altogether include 39 tins of white?
follow_up_questions: A painter buys 11 tins of red paint. How many tins of red paint are left?

problem: Shoppers at the garden centre carried away 28 trays of herbs and 35 trays of flowers this Sunday. The centre had opened at 8 o'clock. How many trays were bought?
follow_up_questions: Last Sunday, 9 fewer trays were bought. How many trays was that?
How many trays were bought on the two Sundays together?

problem: How many bags of groceries left the shop on Monday? The shop has 4 tills, and on Monday customers carried out 28 bags of tins and 35 bags of fresh food.
follow_up_questions: On the Monday before, 9 fewer bags left the shop. How many bags was that?
How many bags left on the two Mondays combined?

problem: On Saturday 9-year-old Ines spent the morning in her uncle's bakery, where she iced 26 lemon cakes and 19 chocolate cakes. What is the number of cakes she iced?
follow_up_questions: Her uncle iced 30 more cakes than she did. How many did he ice?
How many cakes did they ice together?

problem: How many books did Yusuf put back on the shelves? Helping at the library for 2 hours, he shelved 19 picture books and 26 storybooks.
follow_up_questions: The librarian shelved 30 more books than Yusuf. How many did she shelve?
What is the number of books the two of them shelved?

problem: Farmer Okoro set out his market table early: 24 jars of jam at the front and 18 jars of honey behind them. The sun was just coming up. How many jars were on the table?
follow_up_questions: By lunchtime, 29 jars had been sold. How many jars were left on the table?

problem: How many cushions were on the sofas before the party? Dad arranged 24 square cushions and 18 round ones. The room smelled of fresh flowers.
follow_up_questions: By the end of the party, the children had carried 29 cushions off to build a fort. How many cushions were still on the sofas?

problem: Children borrowed 32 audiobooks from the library this week. Adults borrowed the others, making 50 in all. How many did adults borrow?
follow_up_questions: Next week the library expects adults to borrow 6 more audiobooks than this week. How many is that?

problem: How many puppies went to farms? The rescue centre found homes for 50 puppies this year, 32 with families in town and the rest on farms.
follow_up_questions: Next year the centre hopes 6 more puppies than this year will go to farms. How many would that be?

problem: Ivo warms up for 35 minutes at the start of his 90-minute swimming lesson. He spends the rest of the lesson racing. For how many minutes does he race?
follow_up_questions: Next week, racing will take 15 minutes less. How long will racing take then?

problem: How long does Marta spend painting? Her art class on Thursday runs for 90 minutes, and she spends 35 of them sketching before she paints for the rest.
follow_up_questions: In next week's class she plans to paint for 15 minutes less. How long will she paint then?

problem: In all, 85 loaves came out of the bakery's ovens early on Tuesday. The café ordered 48, and every other loaf went to the school. How many loaves did the school get?
follow_up_questions: Later that morning, 16 more loaves for the school came out of the oven. How many school loaves were baked that day?

problem: How many parcels went to the farms? In all, the courier picked up 85 parcels on Friday; 48 went to the town and the others went to the farms.
follow_up_questions: In the evening, 16 more parcels for the farms were picked up. How many farm parcels were there that day?

problem: At the toy shop Joaquin picked out 15 space stickers and then 20 animal stickers. What is the total number of stickers he bought?
follow_up_questions: By Monday he had stuck 12 of them in his book. How many stickers did he have left?
His friend gave him 7 of her stickers. How many stickers does he have now?

problem: How many seed packets did Maryam buy for her garden, if she bought 15 packets of flower seeds and 20 packets of vegetable seeds?
follow_up_questions: She sowed 12 of the packets in April. How many packets did she still have?
Her neighbour gave her 7 packets. How many packets does she have now?

problem: The milkman left 31 bottles on doorsteps along Mill Lane, then left 23 more along Hill Street. How many bottles did he leave altogether?
How many flyers did Odile leave in letterboxes, if she left 31 on Bridge Street and 23 on Station Road?
The cartoon at the cinema sold 78 tickets on Saturday, and the nature film sold 96. The popcorn machine never stopped popping. Find the number of tickets sold that Saturday.
follow_up_questions: Sunday's sales were 45 tickets lower than Saturday's. What were Sunday's sales?
How many tickets were sold over the two days?

problem: How many buns did the bakery sell on Friday? It sold 96 currant buns and 78 iced buns. The baker's apron was covered in flour.
follow_up_questions: On Saturday it sold 45 fewer buns than on Friday. How many buns did it sell on Saturday?
What is the total number of buns sold on Friday and Saturday?

problem: Dr. Sato, the vet, had a long Monday: she checked 38 dogs and 27 cats. What is the number of animals she checked?
follow_up_questions: Of those, 14 needed to come back next week. How many did not need to come back?
On Tuesday morning she checked 9 more cats. How many animals did she check over Monday and Tuesday?

problem: How many items did the librarian scan on Thursday? She scanned 38 books and 27 DVDs before closing.
follow_up_questions: Of those, 14 had to be repaired. How many went straight back on the shelves?
On Friday she scanned 9 more books. How many items had she scanned over Thursday and Friday?

problem: On Monday the park team planted 42 young trees in the morning and 35 in the afternoon. They had 99 trees to plant, so the others were left for Tuesday. How many trees were left for Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday 18 more trees arrive and also need planting. How many trees are planted on Tuesday?

problem: How many sheep must wait until next week? The farmer has 99 sheep to shear; she shears 35 on Saturday and 42 on Friday, and the rest wait for next week.
follow_up_questions: Next week 18 sheep from another farm also need shearing. How many sheep does she shear next week?

problem: Sanjay took 28 photos in the city, 45 in the mountains and 36 at the beach during his holiday. How many photos did he take altogether?
follow_up_questions: He printed all but 15 of them. How many did he print?

problem: What is the number of plants Greta put in her garden? She planted 28 tomato plants, 36 bean plants and 45 lettuces.
follow_up_questions: All but 15 of them grew well. How many grew well?

problem: On Friday the caretaker tipped out the lost-property box and found 58 items: twenty-two coats, and hats for all the rest. The box smelled of wet wool. How many items were hats?
follow_up_questions: Half of the hats belonged to the same class. How many hats was that?
The caretaker found 3 more hats from that class behind the door. How many hats from that class were there now?
Counting the 3 hats from behind the door, how many lost items were there in all?

problem: How many marbles in the jar were green? Mr. Kowalski's jar held 58 marbles, and 22 of them were blue while the rest were green. The jar sits on the classroom windowsill.
follow_up_questions: Half of the green marbles had a white swirl. How many marbles was that?
Then he found 3 more swirly green marbles in his pocket. How many swirly green marbles were there now?
Adding those 3 pocket marbles, how many marbles did he have in total?

problem: Keeper Bryn let 18 visitors feed the goats in the morning. In the afternoon 23 more took a turn. How many visitors fed the goats that day?
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow he expects 6 fewer goat feeders than today. How many is he expecting?

problem: What is the total number of swimmers who used the pool today, if 23 swam in the evening and 18 in the morning, according to the lifeguard?

problem: The library's two reading corners share 35 beanbags. Ade counts 16 in the quiet corner and 3 globes on the shelf above. How many beanbags are in the story corner?
follow_up_questions: The librarian moves 5 beanbags from the story corner to the quiet corner. How many beanbags are in the quiet corner now?
After that, how many beanbags are left in the story corner?

problem: How many tables are in the big hall? The school has 35 tables in its two halls, and 16 are in the small hall. There is also a stage with 8 steps.
follow_up_questions: The caretaker carries 5 tables from the big hall to the small hall. How many tables are in the small hall now?
How many tables remain in the big hall after that?

problem: The river ferry made trips all day. Ada counted 79 cars on the afternoon trips and 94 on the morning trips. How many cars crossed the river that day?

problem: How many dogs did Sara brush? She brushed 9 dogs in the afternoon and 11 dogs in the morning at the grooming salon. The salon smelled of shampoo.

problem: Emeka's 3 friends wait outside the sports shop while he counts balls. He finds 29 footballs, and the shop has 64 balls in all, the rest being basketballs. How many basketballs does the shop have?

problem: A birthday party has ordered 75 vanilla cupcakes and 48 chocolate cupcakes from Moana's bakery. How many cupcakes does she have to get ready?

problem: How many tiles are still to be laid? Hana wants 30 tiles around her fireplace and has laid 21.

problem: Hira picked 8 apples in the orchard, and her mum picked 11. What is the number of apples they picked together?

problem: The library ordered new books: 74 picture books and 89 storybooks arrived in boxes on Monday. How many books came?
How many caps did the club order for its summer tour? The delivery note lists 74 white caps and 89 navy caps.
Ola and her brother Finn went fishing with their grandad. Ola caught 17 fish, and combined they caught 31. How many fish did Finn catch?
follow_up_questions: Before going home, Finn catches 3 more. How many fish has he caught now?

problem: How many baskets did Jin score, if Jin and Pablo scored 31 baskets combined and Pablo scored 17?
follow_up_questions: In the last game, Jin scores 3 more baskets. How many baskets does he have now?

problem: The scrapbook club got a box of stickers from two members: 28 from Tiago and 15 from Mirela. The club meets in the art room on Fridays. How many stickers are in the box?
follow_up_questions: They use 6 stickers on a birthday card. How many stickers are not used?
Keanu gives them a sheet with 13 more stickers. How many unused stickers do they have now?
They share the unused stickers equally among 5 members. How many does each member get?

problem: How many beads did the two friends bring to the craft table? Noa brought 28 and Felix brought 15. The table was covered with an old sheet.
follow_up_questions: They thread 6 beads onto a keyring. How many beads are not used?
Their teacher adds a pot with 13 more beads. How many unused beads are there now?
The unused beads are shared equally among 5 children. How many beads does each child get?

problem: So far the art class has folded 59 paper stars. They want 96 stars hanging from the ceiling. How many more stars must they fold?
follow_up_questions: Amira folds 17 of them at home. How many are left to fold?
The last stars are folded by 4 pupils, each folding the same number. How many does each of them fold?

problem: How many bricks are still to be laid in the garden wall? The wall needs 96 bricks, and the builders have laid 59.
follow_up_questions: Jamal lays 17 of them before tea. How many are left to lay?
The last bricks are laid by 4 builders, each laying the same number. How many does each builder lay?

problem: The art teacher has taught at the school for 20 years and always says yes when pupils ask to borrow paint. Tamsin takes 9 tubes of white and 6 tubes of green for her poster. How many tubes does she borrow?
follow_up_questions: She gives back 4 tubes she didn't use. How many tubes does she still have?

problem: How many books does Aziz check out of the library, which opens 7 days a week? He takes 9 comics and 6 joke books.
follow_up_questions: He returns 4 books the next day. How many books does he still have?

problem: Ines has 40 marbles in a jar. 26 are clear, and every other one is blue. How many blue marbles does she have?
How many of Jun's 40 crayons are wax crayons, if 26 of them are chalk and the others are wax?
Eight badges are already pinned to Sami's backpack. He wants 20 badges on it before the school trip. How many more badges does he need?
follow_up_questions: His uncle sends him 5 badges, and he pins them on. How many more does he need now?

problem: How many more stickers does Lea need? Her sticker chart has 20 spaces, and 8 are already filled.
follow_up_questions: This week she earns 5 more stickers and adds them to the chart. How many spaces are still empty?

problem: Mr. Oduya sewed new curtains for the school stage from 18 metres of black velvet and 13 metres of red velvet. The audience clapped when they saw them. How much velvet did he use?
follow_up_questions: He had bought 40 metres. How much velvet does he have left?

problem: How much rope did the sailors use? They used 18 metres to tie up the boat and 13 metres for the sail. Seagulls circled overhead.
follow_up_questions: They had 40 metres on board. How much rope is left?

problem: The sports club meets at 6 on Mondays and keeps 50 balls in one big bag. Of those, 32 are tennis balls and the rest are footballs. How many footballs are in the bag?
follow_up_questions: A new player takes 3 footballs. How many footballs are left in the bag?
The coach adds 5 footballs from the car. How many footballs are in the bag now?
How many balls are in the bag altogether now, footballs and tennis balls?

problem: How many large paintbrushes are in the pot? The art club's pot holds 50 brushes, 32 of them small, and the club has 7 easels.
follow_up_questions: A new member takes 3 large brushes. How many large brushes are left in the pot?
The teacher adds 5 large brushes from her drawer. How many large brushes are in the pot now?
How many brushes are in the pot altogether now, large and small?

problem: Talia set up 57 dominoes in a long line and 68 in a spiral. How many dominoes did she set up?
follow_up_questions: Her brother adds 25 dominoes to the line. How many dominoes are in the line now?
How many dominoes are in the spiral and the longer line together?

problem: How many cards did Yosef use? His card house has 68 cards in it, and his card bridge has 57.
follow_up_questions: His friend adds 25 cards to the bridge. How many cards are in the bridge now?
How many cards are in the house and the bigger bridge together?

problem: Pia's button tin holds 45 buttons. 30 of them have four holes and the others have two holes. How many buttons have two holes?
How many of Dmitri's 45 stamps are from other countries, if 30 are from his own country?
Fatou built a card tower with 26 cards in the bottom part and 18 in the top part, and told her brother not to take away a single card. How many cards are in her tower?
follow_up_questions: Her brother takes 9 cards off the bottom anyway. How many cards are left in the tower?

problem: How many sandbags are in the flood barrier? The officer warns that nobody may take away a single bag, as the volunteers finish stacking 18 bags on one side and 26 on the other.
follow_up_questions: The water pushes 9 bags off the barrier. How many bags are left in the barrier?

problem: Aiko's jigsaw has 84 pieces. She finds the 39 edge pieces first, and all the others show sky or sea. The picture on the lid is a lighthouse. How many sky and sea pieces are there?
follow_up_questions: 17 of them are sky pieces. How many sea pieces are there?
She loses 3 sea pieces under the rug. How many sea pieces does she still have?

problem: How many crayons and markers are in the art kit? The kit holds 84 items, 39 of them pencils, and the rest are crayons and markers. It came in a shiny tin.
follow_up_questions: Of those, 17 are crayons. How many markers are there?
Then 3 markers dry out and are thrown away. How many markers are still in the kit?

problem: For their model farm, Naledi glued 24 sticks into a barn and Oscar glued 33 sticks into fences. How many sticks are in the model farm?
follow_up_questions: They add a pond with 12 sticks around it. How many sticks are in the farm now?

problem: How many bricks are in the toy town? Ali used 24 bricks for the shops and Grace used 33 for the houses.
follow_up_questions: They build a bridge out of 12 more bricks. How many bricks are in the town now?

problem: On his 8th day at the beach, Tane builds a sandcastle from 60 buckets of sand. The towers use 24 buckets and the walls use the rest. How many buckets of sand are in the walls?
follow_up_questions: A wave washes away 9 buckets of wall. How many buckets of wall are still standing?
Tane adds 5 buckets back to the walls. How many buckets of wall stand now?
How many buckets of sand does the castle have now, towers and walls together?

problem: How many of the 60 cupcakes on the party table are plain? Ruth's mum set them out for the 8 guests, and 24 have sprinkles while the rest are plain.
follow_up_questions: The guests eat 9 plain cupcakes. How many plain cupcakes are left?
Ruth's mum brings out 5 more plain cupcakes. How many plain cupcakes are on the table now?
How many cupcakes are on the table now, plain and sprinkled together?

problem: Amara would like two craft kits for her birthday: one with 98 jewels and one with 75 beads. If she gets both, how many beads and jewels will she have?
How many stickers will Hugo own if he buys both sticker books at the shop, one with 98 stickers and one with 75?
Kamal counts 52 books on the library trolley, which takes 70 books when it is full. How many books are missing from the trolley?
follow_up_questions: Readers bring 11 books back to the trolley. How many are still missing?
'Let's find four more,' says Kamal. If those 4 go back on the trolley too, how many books will be on it?

problem: How many paintbrushes are missing from the art room jar? It holds 70 brushes when full, but Ms. Lee sees only 52 in it.
follow_up_questions: Pupils return 11 brushes. How many are still missing?
If 4 more brushes turn up and go back in the jar, how many brushes will the jar hold?

problem: Chloe collected shells all week. She found 32 on Tuesday and 45 on Monday. How many shells does she have now?
follow_up_questions: She uses 50 shells to decorate a picture frame. How many shells does she have left?

problem: How many gems does Tavi have in his game now, if he won 32 gems in the forest world and 45 in the ice world?
follow_up_questions: He spends 50 gems on a new sword. How many gems does he have left?

problem: The garden hides 48 chocolate eggs for the Easter hunt. After 2 hours of searching, Lucas has found 29. How many eggs are still hidden?
follow_up_questions: He finds 7 more eggs after lunch. How many are still hidden?
If he finds 4 eggs each hour after that, how many hours will it take to find the rest?

problem: How many puzzle pieces are still in the box? Imogen's puzzle has 48 pieces, and in 5 evenings she has put 29 of them in place.
follow_up_questions: She places 7 more pieces the next evening. How many are still in the box?
If she places 4 pieces each evening after that, how many evenings will it take to finish?

problem: At the orchard, Mateo picked 28 cherries. Together with Sunita he picked 53. How many cherries did Sunita pick?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, Sunita picks 9 more. How many cherries has she picked in all?

problem: How many points did Elif get, if she and Jonas earned 53 points together in the spelling bee and Jonas got 28?
follow_up_questions: In the second round, Elif earns 9 points. How many points has she earned in both rounds?

problem: There are 24 guppies and 19 goldfish swimming in Arlo's aquarium. The biggest goldfish is called Bubbles. How many fish are in the aquarium?
follow_up_questions: He gives 13 guppies to his cousin. How many fish are left in the aquarium?
Then he buys 5 tetras. How many fish are in his aquarium now?
Each fish eats 2 food flakes a day. How many flakes does he need each day?

problem: How many birds live in the zoo's aviary? It houses 24 parrots and 19 finches. The keeper whistles while she sweeps.
follow_up_questions: The zoo moves 13 parrots to a new aviary. How many birds are left in the old one?
Then 5 canaries arrive. How many birds are in the old aviary now?
Each bird gets 2 slices of apple at noon. How many slices does the keeper need?

problem: Kai's 3-metre bookshelf holds 21 adventure novels and 16 comic books. How many books are on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: He gives away 8 comic books he has finished. How many books are left on his shelf?

problem: How many songs are on Ayla's playlist? It has 21 pop songs and 16 rock songs, and she made it on a 4-hour train ride.
follow_up_questions: She deletes 8 rock songs she no longer likes. How many songs are left on the playlist?

problem: Of the 39 pies the corner bakery made today, 21 are apple. All the others are cherry. Find the number of cherry pies.
How many of the 39 new library books are in Spanish, if 21 are in English and the rest are in Spanish?
In the quiz, Yetunde's team scored 68 points in round two after scoring 47 in round one, which they lost. How many points did they score in the two rounds?
follow_up_questions: The other team scored 20 more points than Yetunde's team over the two rounds. How many points did the other team score?
How many points did the two teams score altogether?

problem: How many runs did the village cricket team make in its two matches? It lost both, but made 68 runs in the second match and 47 in the first.
follow_up_questions: Their opponents made 20 more runs than the village team across the two matches. How many runs did the opponents make?
How many runs were made by both teams together?

problem: A tin of crayons should hold 32, but Noor counts only 29 inside. How many crayons are missing?
follow_up_questions: Her sister finds 2 behind the radiator. How many crayons are still missing?

problem: How many teaspoons are missing from the set of 32, if Grandma can only find 29 in the drawer?
follow_up_questions: Grandpa finds 2 in the garden shed. How many teaspoons are still missing?

problem: Siddharth and his friends have played 5 turns of a marble game. 45 marbles now sit in the holes on the board, and the game started with 60 marbles in the pouch. How many marbles are still in the pouch?
follow_up_questions: In the next turn the players take 8 marbles from the pouch. How many are left in it?
They put all of those marbles in the holes on the board. How many marbles are on the board now?
Then 3 marbles roll back into the pouch. How many marbles are in the pouch now?

problem: How many counters are still in the box? A counting game comes with 60 counters, and after 4 minutes of play Jade has 45 on the table.
follow_up_questions: Next, the players take 8 counters from the box. How many counters are left in it?
They place those counters on the table too. How many counters are on the table now?
Then 3 counters are put back into the box. How many counters are in the box now?

problem: The toy library lends out 49 toy cars and 63 puzzles. How many toys does it have in all?
follow_up_questions: Families borrow 27 toys. How many toys are still on the shelves?
The librarian brings 15 new toys from the storeroom. How many toys are on the shelves now?

problem: How many DVDs does the community centre own if it has 49 films and 63 cartoons?
follow_up_questions: Members borrow 27 DVDs for the weekend. How many DVDs are still on the shelves?
The manager adds 15 donated DVDs. How many are on the shelves now?

problem: Eamon's dominoes game started with a pile of 24 dominoes. Now just 14 are left in the pile. How many dominoes have been played?
How many crackers have been eaten, if the plate started with 24 crackers and Mona sees only 14 left?
Sofia counted the pieces in her old jigsaw box, knowing a few had gone missing. She found 18 middle pieces and 21 edge pieces. How many pieces does the jigsaw have now?
follow_up_questions: A full jigsaw has 52 pieces. How many pieces are missing?

problem: How many crayons are in Theo's box now? Some had gone missing, but he counts 18 blue crayons and 21 red crayons.
follow_up_questions: A full box has 52 crayons. How many are missing?

problem: In his mum's recipe box there are 90 cards. 43 are cake recipes and the rest are soup recipes. The kitchen smells of fresh bread. How many soup recipes are in the box?
follow_up_questions: Lars tries 19 soup recipes this winter. How many soup cards have not been tried?
Those cards are shared out equally among 4 cousins to try. How many cards does each cousin get?

problem: How many flash cards are about verbs? Wanjiru has 90 language flash cards, and 43 are about nouns; the rest are about verbs. Her cat likes to sleep on them.
follow_up_questions: She learns 19 verb cards this week. How many verb cards has she not learned?
Those cards are split equally among 4 study days. How many cards does she study each day?

problem: Ronan decorated 13 cookies for the school fair, and his aunt decorated 16. How many cookies did they decorate?
follow_up_questions: Customers buy 10 decorated cookies. How many are left on the stall?

problem: How many birdhouses did Sakura and her grandma build for the garden sale? Grandma built 16 and Sakura built 13.
follow_up_questions: Neighbours buy 10 of them. How many birdhouses are left?

problem: The pool opens at 9, and Amira's group of 29 children arrives first. The coach sends 18 of them to swim lengths and the rest to the diving boards. How many children are diving?
follow_up_questions: The divers split into a low-board group of 6 and a high-board group. How many are in the high-board group?
Each child in the high-board group gets 4 dives. How many dives does the high-board group get?
Each child in the low-board group gets 3 dives. How many dives do all the divers get?

problem: How many campers are painting? At the 3-day art camp, 29 campers are split up: 18 are drawing, and the rest are painting.
follow_up_questions: The painters split into a group of 6 using watercolours and a group using oils. How many are in the oils group?
Each camper in the oils group paints 4 pictures. How many pictures does the oils group paint?
Each camper in the watercolour group paints 3 pictures. How many pictures do all the painters make?

problem: Asha's shoe shop has 46 pairs of sandals and 58 pairs of boots in stock. How many pairs of shoes are in stock?
How many tents does the camping shop have in stock? The owner counts 46 small tents and 58 family tents.
16 players turn up for beach volleyball. Lucia notices that 9 are girls and the others are boys. How many boys are playing?
follow_up_questions: Then 2 more boys arrive and join in. How many boys are playing now?
How many players are on the beach now?

problem: How many adults are in the choir tonight? Of the 16 singers, 9 are children.
follow_up_questions: Then 2 more adults arrive late and join in. How many adults are singing now?
How many singers are in the choir now?

problem: The hook-a-duck stall at the school fair gave away 19 goldfish in the afternoon and 23 in the morning. The goldfish swam in little plastic bags. Find the total number of goldfish won that day.
follow_up_questions: The stall had 50 goldfish when it opened. How many are still left?
The owner brings 15 more goldfish from the van. How many goldfish does the stall have now?

problem: How many prizes were handed out at the bowling alley's prize desk? In the evening 19 prizes were claimed, and earlier in the day 23 were claimed. The desk was decorated with balloons.
follow_up_questions: The desk had 50 prizes at opening time. How many are still left?
The manager brings 15 more prizes from the storeroom. How many prizes does the desk have now?
